attacks.name: Crownless - Echo Skill
attacks.sourceText:
Transform into Crownless and perform up to 4 consecutive attacks. The first 2 attacks deal 83.80% Havoc DMG each, the 3rd attack deals 62.85% Havoc DMG 2 times, and the 4th attack deals 41.90% Havoc DMG 3 times.
After the transformation, increase current character's Havoc DMG by 12.00% and Resonance Skill DMG by 12.00% for 15s.
